gantt_dates.purpose: Real start_date/due_date per task node, so /gantt and the seeded task rows stop deriving dates from the roadmap column.
policy: start_date = the earliest DATED evidence of work on the node (git commit, Kanban card event, or a dated note).
due_date = the latest DATED evidence of completion for a finished piece of work; for an open node only if a plan deadline is documented — otherwise EMPTY.
Never estimated, interpolated, or copied from the column. A node with no evidence stays undated and carries 'date_source' saying why.
A passed plan date on an unfinished node is either re-baselined to dated evidence (T-028, T-029) or the node is marked blocked with 'blocked_reason' (T-025, T-026) — never silently shifted.
Evidence sources used: git log on lexflow_hermes_v1, ~/.hermes/kanban.db card events/comments, and the dated notes already in each node. No external assumption was used.

tasks.title: Add Alembic migration for notify_consents (currently create_all-only) before Railway gate
tasks.notes: MAJOR finding from Wave 1 FINAL GATE (2026-10-25, integration/platform-wave1 @ 78238fe, report xreport_admy_wave1.md): notify_consents has NO Alembic migration — it is created only via runtime db.create_all() in the _ensure_schema before_request hook (checkfirst+additive). On a fresh Postgres deploy where only 'flask db upgrade' runs the migrations, the first db.create_all() still creates it (additive, so it self-heals), but it is ABSENT from the migration chain and from the ORM model registry import graph. MINOR companion: NotifyConsent not in models/__init__. Fix before the Railway deploy gate (T-025).
